heroSlides.text: A private day among the lion rock, village gardens, and the painted caves of Dambulla.

heroSlides.title: Ride the green line to Ella
heroSlides.text: Tea hills, the Nine Arch Bridge, and a slow train through the highlands.

destinations.name: Sigiriya
destinations.summary: A palace in the sky above forest and paddy, with village life still moving at its foot.

destinations.name: Kandy
destinations.summary: The lake city of the Temple of the Tooth, dancers at dusk, and gardens in the hills.

destinations.name: Ella
destinations.summary: Cloud forests, little waterfall walks, and the famous blue train on the Nine Arch Bridge.

destinations.name: Nuwara Eliya
destinations.summary: Cool air, tea factories, and hills combed into bright green rows.

destinations.name: Galle
destinations.summary: A living Dutch fort of ramparts, courtyards, and the Indian Ocean at the lighthouse.

destinations.name: Mirissa
destinations.summary: A crescent of sand where the season brings blue whales just offshore.

destinations.name: Bentota
destinations.summary: River mangroves, a quiet beach, and an easy escape from Colombo.

destinations.name: Yala
destinations.summary: Sri Lanka’s most famous park, where leopards share the scrub with elephants and birds.

destinations.name: Udawalawe
destinations.summary: Open grassland and one of the most reliable places to see elephant herds.

destinations.name: Colombo
destinations.summary: A capital of temples, markets, colonial facades, and a seafront that wakes at sunset.

destinations.name: Pinnawala
destinations.summary: A riverside morning with elephants, on the way between Colombo and the cultural triangle.

destinations.name: Trincomalee
destinations.summary: A deep-water bay, quiet beaches, and a headland temple above the sea.

destinations.name: Anuradhapura
destinations.summary: The island’s ancient capital of stupas, sacred trees, and wide monastic parks.

destinations.name: Polonnaruwa
destinations.summary: Gal Vihara’s stone Buddhas and the ruins of a medieval royal city.

stays.name: Jungle pavilion
stays.summary: Low buildings under trees, with the rock visible from the pool at breakfast.

stays.name: Lake-view manor
stays.summary: A quiet house above the lake, close enough to walk to the evening temple.

stays.name: Tea bungalow
stays.summary: A small bungalow in the tea, with cool nights and a path toward the bridge.

stays.name: Fort house
stays.summary: Courtyard rooms inside the ramparts, a short walk from the lighthouse.

stays.name: Beach villa
stays.summary: A villa set back from the sand, timed for whale season and slow afternoons.

stays.name: Safari camp
stays.summary: Canvas and timber just outside the park, so dawn drives start before the heat.

testimonials.name: Amelia Brooks
testimonials.title: The driver felt like a friend
testimonials.quote: Every morning the car was ready, the days were never rushed, and Sigiriya at opening time was worth the early start.

testimonials.name: Jonas Meier
testimonials.title: Wildlife without the scramble
testimonials.quote: Our Yala morning was quiet and well timed. We saw elephants before the jeep queues, then tea in the hills two days later.

testimonials.name: Priya Nair
testimonials.title: A coast that still felt personal
testimonials.quote: Galle Fort at golden hour and a calm Mirissa boat. Serendrift changed the plan when the sea was rough, and told us why.

testimonials.name: Helen and Mark Doyle
testimonials.title: The train day still makes us smile
testimonials.quote: They put us on the right Ella train carriage, met us at the station, and had the bungalow ready with the kettle on.

reasons.title: A driver who stays with you
reasons.text: One private vehicle and one driver-guide for the journey, so the days connect instead of starting from scratch.

reasons.title: A pace you can actually enjoy
reasons.text: We leave room for a swim, a long lunch, or a temple that needs quiet. The timetable bends around you.

reasons.title: Stays we would use ourselves
reasons.text: Jungle lodges, fort houses, and tea bungalows chosen for character, comfort, and where they sit on the route.

reasons.title: The island, told from here
reasons.text: Routes are built in Sri Lanka: which gate opens first, when the whales are in, and which road floods in the rains.

about.heading: Journeys shaped on the island, not from a brochure
about.lead: Serendrift plans private Sri Lanka travel for people who want the famous places, and the quiet hours around them.
about.body: Tell us who is travelling, how you like to move, and what you hope to feel. We answer with a route, a vehicle, and stays that fit. You can follow one of our journeys or rewrite it. Either way, a driver stays with you, and a planner stays on the message when the day changes.

tours.title: Sigiriya Heritage & Village
tours.summary: Lion Rock at opening time, a village garden lunch, and the cave temples of Dambulla.
tours.description: This is the cultural triangle in a single unhurried day. You climb Sigiriya while the light is still kind, come down through the water gardens, then eat in a village house before the painted caves of Dambulla. The vehicle and driver stay with you between every stop.
highlights: Pidurangala viewpoint, if you still have the legs

itinerary.title: Sunrise approach
itinerary.detail: Pickup and a drive to the rock so you start the climb before the heat and the coaches.

itinerary.title: Lion Rock
itinerary.detail: Water gardens, mirror wall, and the summit palace, with time to come down at your pace.

itinerary.title: Village lunch
itinerary.detail: A short ride through paddy and gardens, then a home-cooked rice and curry.

itinerary.title: Dambulla
itinerary.detail: The cave temple complex, then the drive back to your hotel.

includes: Hotel or airport pickup on the tour day

tours.title: Kandy Culture & Nature
tours.summary: The Temple of the Tooth, the royal botanic gardens, and a lakeside evening.
tours.description: Kandy rewards a day that is not packed too tightly. You walk the Temple of the Tooth, wander the huge trees at Peradeniya, and return to the lake as the city cools. A cultural dance can be added in the evening.

itinerary.title: Temple morning
itinerary.detail: A guided walk through the Temple of the Tooth complex.

itinerary.title: Lake and lanes
itinerary.detail: Time around the lake and the streets of the old grid.

itinerary.title: Peradeniya
itinerary.detail: The royal botanic gardens, including the great avenue of palms.

itinerary.title: Evening choice
itinerary.detail: Return to your hotel, or stay for a Kandyan dance performance.

includes: Hotel or airport pickup on the tour day

tours.title: Whales & Galle Heritage
tours.summary: A morning on the water for whales and dolphins, then the ramparts of Galle Fort.
tours.description: In season, the boat leaves Mirissa early. You spend the late morning in Galle: lighthouse, churches, courtyards, and a long lunch inside the fort. If the sea is too rough, we reshape the day along the coast and tell you before you set an alarm.

itinerary.title: Harbour
itinerary.detail: Early pickup and a licensed boat from Mirissa when conditions allow.

itinerary.title: On the water
itinerary.detail: A few hours offshore for whales and dolphins. Sightings are wild, never promised.

itinerary.title: Galle Fort
itinerary.detail: A walking tour of the ramparts, the lighthouse, and the quiet inner streets.

itinerary.title: Coast road home
itinerary.detail: A relaxed drive back with a stop if the light is good.

includes: Hotel or airport pickup on the tour day

tours.title: Bentota River Retreat
tours.summary: A mangrove boat, a river island lunch, and time on a wide south-coast beach.
tours.description: An easy day from Colombo or a south-coast hotel. The boat slips through mangroves, you eat on the river, and the afternoon is yours on the beach. It is a gentle introduction to the coast.

itinerary.title: River
itinerary.detail: A boat through the Bentota mangroves with a local boatman.

itinerary.title: Island lunch
itinerary.detail: Rice and curry on a small river island.

itinerary.title: Beach
itinerary.detail: Free time on the sand. Swimming depends on the day’s sea.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.detail: Drive back along the coast before the evening traffic.

includes: Hotel or airport pickup on the tour day

tours.title: Pinnawala Elephant Discovery
tours.summary: Watch the herd walk to the river, then continue toward the spice gardens or Kandy.
tours.description: A straightforward day for travellers who want elephants without a full safari. You see the Pinnawala herd at the river, then choose a spice garden or the climb toward Kandy.

itinerary.title: Morning drive
itinerary.detail: Leave early enough to arrive before the main river hour.

itinerary.title: The herd
itinerary.detail: Time at the orphanage and along the riverbank.

itinerary.title: Spice garden
itinerary.detail: A short walk through cinnamon, vanilla, and pepper.

itinerary.title: Onward
itinerary.detail: Continue to Kandy or return to Colombo.

includes: Hotel or airport pickup on the tour day

tours.title: Yala Leopard Safari
tours.summary: A private jeep into Yala’s scrub, timed for the hours when cats and herds are moving.
tours.description: Yala is busy because it is wonderful. We book the jeep and the gate slot so you are inside while the light is still low. Leopards are never guaranteed. Elephants, deer, peacocks, and a very good picnic usually are.

itinerary.title: Before dawn
itinerary.detail: Pickup from your Tissamaharama or Yala stay.

itinerary.title: Gate
itinerary.detail: Enter with a tracker who reads the tracks and the other jeeps.

itinerary.title: Drive
itinerary.detail: About four hours on the park tracks, with stops when the animals allow.

itinerary.title: Late morning
itinerary.detail: Leave before the heat and return for a swim or a rest.

includes: Hotel or airport pickup on the tour day

tours.title: Udawalawe Elephant Safari
tours.summary: A wide-open park where elephant herds are the main event, not a lucky glimpse.
tours.description: Udawalawe is the confident choice for elephants. The land is open, the herds are used to the jeeps, and the drive sits neatly between the hills and the south coast.
highlights: Easy link to Ella or the coast

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.detail: Meet the jeep at the park, or ride with your driver to the gate.

itinerary.title: Game drive
itinerary.detail: A half-day safari focused on herds, waterbirds, and the reservoir.

itinerary.title: Transit centre
itinerary.detail: Optional stop at the elephant transit home nearby.

itinerary.title: Continue
itinerary.detail: Drive on to Ella, Galle, or your next stay.

includes: Hotel or airport pickup on the tour day

tours.title: Ella Scenic Highlands
tours.summary: Tea hills, a waterfall pause, and the Nine Arch Bridge with the train if the timetable agrees.
tours.description: The highlands are a day of weather and views. You walk a tea trail, stop where the water falls beside the road, and time the Nine Arch Bridge for a train if one is due. We check the rail times the evening before.
highlights: Little Adam’s Peak or a tea walk

itinerary.title: Tea
itinerary.detail: A factory or a hillside walk among the pickers, depending on the hour.

itinerary.title: Bridge
itinerary.detail: Time at Nine Arch Bridge, matched to a train when the schedule allows.

itinerary.title: Ridge
itinerary.detail: A short climb for the valley view, only as far as the group wants.

itinerary.title: Evening
itinerary.detail: Back to your Ella stay while the hills turn blue.

includes: Hotel or airport pickup on the tour day

tours.title: Colombo Heritage Walk
tours.summary: Gangaramaya, the old fort quarter, a market, and the seafront as the city changes gear.
tours.description: A half or full day for arrivals and departures. You see the capital as a port city: a kaleidoscopic temple, colonial streets, and the ocean at Galle Face. It is an easy first or last day.

itinerary.title: Temple
itinerary.detail: Gangaramaya, with its courtyards and unexpected collections.

itinerary.title: Fort and Pettah
itinerary.detail: A walk or a short drive through the commercial heart.

itinerary.title: Lunch
itinerary.detail: A Colombo classic: hoppers, seafood, or a calm hotel restaurant.

itinerary.title: Seafront
itinerary.detail: Galle Face as the kite flyers come out.

includes: Hotel or airport pickup on the tour day

tours.title: Sri Lanka Quick Explore
tours.summary: Six days that still feel complete: rock, lake city, tea train, and the fort.
tours.description: For a first visit with a firm flight home. You land, climb Sigiriya, sleep by Kandy lake, cross the tea hills to Ella, and finish inside Galle Fort. The route is private, so a late flight or a tired child can shift a day without losing the story.

itinerary.title: Day 1 — Arrival
itinerary.detail: Airport meet and a gentle drive. Overnight near Negombo or Colombo.

itinerary.title: Day 2 — Sigiriya
itinerary.detail: Climb the rock and sleep in the cultural triangle.

itinerary.title: Day 3 — Kandy
itinerary.detail: Spice country on the way, temple by the lake in the evening.

itinerary.title: Day 4 — Ella
itinerary.detail: Into the tea. Train if seats are open, car alongside if they are not.

itinerary.title: Day 5 — Galle
itinerary.detail: Down to the fort. Ramparts and a night by the sea.

itinerary.title: Day 6 — Departure
itinerary.detail: A swim if the flight allows, then the airport.

includes: Sigiriya and temple tickets listed in the plan

tours.title: Adventure & Romance
tours.location: Hills, Yala, and the south coast
tours.summary: A private route for two: rock fortress, a safari dawn, and nights near the sea.
tours.description: Built for couples who want a little adventure and a lot of ease. You share a private vehicle, a jeep at Yala, and slower evenings in Ella and on the south coast. We can mark a birthday dinner or a quiet proposal viewpoint.

itinerary.title: Days 1–2 — Sigiriya
itinerary.detail: Arrive and spend a full day at the rock and the village.

itinerary.title: Day 3 — Kandy
itinerary.detail: Temple evening and a manor above the lake.

itinerary.title: Days 4–5 — Ella
itinerary.detail: Train, tea, and a bungalow night.

itinerary.title: Day 6 — Yala
itinerary.detail: Safari at dawn and a camp near the park.

itinerary.title: Days 7–8 — Coast
itinerary.detail: Mirissa or Galle, then the airport.

tours.title: Ramayana Sacred Trail
tours.summary: A respectful route through places pilgrims and storytellers still visit.
tours.description: This journey follows sites associated with the Ramayana in Sri Lanka, from the highlands to the east-coast headland. It is planned with time for temples, not as a checklist. Tell us if your group needs a priest, a quieter hour, or vegetarian kitchens.

itinerary.title: Days 1–2 — Colombo & the hills
itinerary.detail: Arrival and the climb into tea country.

itinerary.title: Days 3–4 — Nuwara Eliya & Ella
itinerary.detail: Sites and viewpoints in the highlands, with rest built in.

itinerary.title: Day 5 — Kandy
itinerary.detail: The Temple of the Tooth and the lake.

itinerary.title: Days 6–7 — East
itinerary.detail: Across to Trincomalee and the headland temple.

itinerary.title: Day 8 — Homeward
itinerary.detail: A scenic return toward the airport.

tours.title: Hidden Treasures
tours.location: Ruins, hills, herds, and the fort
tours.summary: Ten days with the famous sights and the quieter hours between them.
tours.description: A classic first long trip. Ancient cities, a real safari, the train hills, and a fort that you get to wake up inside. The extra days are what keep it from feeling like a chase.

itinerary.title: Days 1–3 — Cultural triangle
itinerary.detail: Sigiriya, a village day, and Polonnaruwa’s stone Buddhas.

itinerary.title: Days 4–5 — Kandy
itinerary.detail: Temple, gardens, and a slow morning by the lake.

itinerary.title: Days 6–7 — Highlands
itinerary.detail: Tea country and Ella.

itinerary.title: Day 8 — Udawalawe
itinerary.detail: Elephant safari on the way south.

itinerary.title: Days 9–10 — Galle
itinerary.detail: Fort nights and departure.

tours.title: Culture & Heritage
tours.location: Ancient cities to the southern fort
tours.summary: A deeper cultural arc, from the ancient capitals to Kandy and Galle.
tours.description: For travellers who care about the story of the island. You move through Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Sigiriya, and Kandy with enough nights to walk twice if a place catches you. The south coast is the exhale at the end.

itinerary.title: Days 1–4 — Ancient cities
itinerary.detail: Anuradhapura, Aukana or Mihintale, then Polonnaruwa and Sigiriya.

itinerary.title: Days 5–6 — Kandy
itinerary.detail: Temple, gardens, and a craft or dance evening.

itinerary.title: Days 7–9 — Hills
itinerary.detail: Train country, tea, and Ella.

itinerary.title: Days 10–12 — South & Colombo
itinerary.detail: Galle, a beach morning, and a city farewell.

tours.title: Grand Highlights
tours.location: The long way around the island
tours.summary: Two weeks of private travel: ancient cities, both hill towns, two parks, and the south coast.
tours.description: The journey we suggest when you have the days. Nothing is done as a drive-by. You sleep near the places you came to see, cross the highlands properly, and take two different safaris so elephants and the chance of leopard are not squeezed into one morning.

itinerary.title: Days 1–5 — North and the triangle
itinerary.detail: Arrival, Anuradhapura, Sigiriya, and Polonnaruwa.

itinerary.title: Days 6–7 — Kandy
itinerary.detail: Lake, temple, and gardens.

itinerary.title: Days 8–10 — Highlands
itinerary.detail: Nuwara Eliya’s tea and Ella’s bridge.

itinerary.title: Days 11–12 — Parks
itinerary.detail: Udawalawe and a Yala dawn.

itinerary.title: Days 13–15 — Coast
itinerary.detail: Mirissa, Galle, and a Colombo departure.
